brief: Sales kick-off in or near Munich for 120 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-01-20. We need a plenary room plus 4 breakout rooms for the regional sessions. Budget EUR 70,000 all in.

input.query: Munich conference hotel plenary breakout rooms sales kick-off

input.summary: Three Munich-area venues are open on 2027-01-20 and all quote under the EUR 70,000 budget. All three need budget-owner sign-off because they are over EUR 20,000, and the quotes include an EUR 18,000 group travel estimate. The planner gave no dietary or wheelchair needs, so the RFP lists none.

offers.tradeOff: Cheapest option and has 5 breakout rooms; the 150-seat hall is the smallest plenary of the top two, and the venue is lively rather than quiet.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Best fit for a sales kick-off: 250-seat plenary, 8 breakout rooms and a large foyer; costs about EUR 2,760 more than Alte Maelzerei.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Mountain-view setting, but it is the priciest, has exactly 4 breakout rooms, a 130-seat hall, and the longest trip from Berlin (about 5 hours by train).
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: RFP: Sales kick-off, 120 guests, arrival 2027-01-20, 1 night
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a sales kick-off and would like a proposal.

Arrival: 2027-01-20, departure 2027-01-21 (1 night)
Guests: 120
Room nights: 120 single-occupancy rooms x 1 night
Meeting space: 1 plenary room for 120 people plus 4 breakout rooms for regional sessions
Catering: day delegate package with lunch and coffee. Dietary needs: none reported so far.
Accessibility: no wheelchair users reported; step-free access is preferred.
Budget: up to EUR 70,000 all in.

Please send availability, a itemised price and your terms by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
